name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 110 - Am 25/1
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 110a. Reiterates that Members of the European Parliament must act in accordance with the Code of Conduct for Members of the European Parliament regarding integrity and transparency; recommends in this regard that an audit be performed on the general allowance of and all other forms of financial contributions to Members of the European Parliament on a yearly basis in order to increase Parliament’s transparency and trust in its Members among the citizens of the EU as well as reduce the risk of undue influence, interference or corruption;
